description: Shared knowledge base where specialist agents read hypotheses and post discoveries. Starts: researcher (posts the first hypothesis to `blackboard`). Analyst and synthesizer wait for entries on `blackboard`, then post validations and the final synthesis there.
name: blackboard

description: Multi-tier command hierarchy where managers supervise specialized worker teams. Starts: director (level 0; publishes directives to `root-orders`). Managers wait for `root-orders`, publish assignments to `team-orders` and report to `root-results`; specialists wait for `team-orders` and publish to `team-results`.
name: hierarchical

description: Competitive market where solvers bid on asks coordinated by a market-maker. Starts: requesters (publish `ask` from the objective). Solvers wait for `ask` and publish `bid`; the market-maker waits for `ask`/`bid` and publishes the `transaction`; requesters and solvers then react to it.
name: market

description: Central orchestrator dispatches partitioned tasks to a worker pool and aggregates results. Starts: orchestrator (receives the objective, publishes task orders to `orders`). Workers wait for `orders` and publish results to `results`; the orchestrator aggregates them.
name: orchestrator-worker
